edges.label: method extension
edges.explanation: NeuroLM explicitly follows LaBraM neural tokenizer with changes to temporal/frequency reconstruction and adversarial alignment; not a claim of reusing pretrained LaBraM weights.

edges.label: numerical embedding method reuse
edges.explanation: The final Mantis architecture explicitly encodes raw patch mean/std using the multi-scaled scalar encoder from NuTime (Lin et al., 2024). This is method reuse, not pretrained NuTime weight transfer.

edges.label: code reuse
edges.explanation: Authors state TF-C is implemented under the TS-TCC codebase; this is implementation reuse, not pretrained-weight inheritance.

edges.label: code reuse
edges.explanation: Official README explicitly states the implementation is based on TS2Vec; the paper also reuses its hierarchical contextual-contrastive design.

edges.label: architecture and objective reuse
edges.explanation: Retains TS2Vec residual-block design/objective for specialists; student adds dual stems and distillation.

edges.label: synthetic data generator reuse
edges.explanation: Explicitly pretrains on synthetic series generated by CauKer.

edges.label: frozen encoder reuse
edges.explanation: ECGFounder supplies the frozen ECG encoder; its projection head and the PPG branch are trained. ECGFounder is not the existing ECG-FM entry.

edges.label: CauKer pretraining for 2026 synthetic variants
edges.explanation: The expanded 2026 Mantis family paper uses CauKer-generated pretraining sequences. This edge concerns Mantis+/MantisV2, not the original February 2025 real-data checkpoint.
